title: A story to share
sub: A quiet moment. A whole new world.

books.title: The little seed
books.description: A tiny seed discovers that growing takes patience, care, and its own special time.
copy: A little seed rested in the soft earth. “When will I grow?” it wondered.
Rain tapped gently on the ground. The seed drank, rested, and reached one tiny root into the earth.
One morning, a green leaf reached toward the sun. The seed had been growing all along.

books.title: A kind little moment
books.description: Milo learns that a small act of kindness can make someone’s whole day feel brighter.
copy: Milo saw someone sitting alone. He slowed down and gave a little wave.
“There is room beside me,” said Milo. Soon two quiet smiles became a happy conversation.
The next day, Milo felt shy. His new friend waved him over. A little kindness had found its way back.

books.title: The colour cloud
books.description: A little cloud changes colour with every feeling and learns that all feelings are welcome.
copy: The little cloud woke up blue. It told the sky, “I feel a little sad today.”
Later, a loud wind made the cloud feel red and cross. It paused for one slow breath, then another.
The cloud discovered it could feel many things. Every colour belonged in its sky.

books.title: My brave little step
books.description: Tara takes one small step toward something new, with a trusted hand beside her.
copy: The stepping stones looked a little far apart. Tara held her grown-up’s hand.
She tried the nearest stone first. Then she paused, looked, and tried the next one.
“I tried something new,” Tara said. Being brave could happen one little step at a time.

books.title: Together we shine
books.description: Three little stars discover that helping one another makes the night a little brighter.
copy: Three little stars wanted to light the path below. One was bright, one was small, and one was shy.
They moved closer and each shared a little sparkle. No one had to shine alone.
Together, they made a gentle light. There was a place for every star in their sky.

books.title: The moon’s goodnight
books.description: Follow the moon on a gentle journey as the world settles down for sleep.
copy: The moon peeked over the hill. All around, the busy day began to slow.
“Goodnight, trees. Goodnight, birds,” whispered the moon. The world grew softer and quieter.
One last window glowed. A little child closed their eyes, and the moon kept gentle watch.

books.title: Where did my giggle go?
books.description: On a grumpy day, Nia learns to name her feelings and find comfort without rushing her smile.
copy: Nia could not find her giggle. Everything felt too loud and a little bit wrong.
“Maybe I need a cuddle and some quiet,” she said. Her grown-up listened and stayed close.
After a while, a funny little thought arrived. Nia smiled when she was ready.

books.title: Pip and the puddle
books.description: A rainy-day walk becomes a little adventure full of noticing, wondering, and safe splashing.
copy: Pip put on boots and stepped outside with a grown-up. Rain had left little puddles along the path.
In one puddle, Pip spotted a cloud and a tree. The tiny pool was holding a piece of the sky.
With space around and a hand nearby, Pip made one happy splash. The rainy day had a new story.

books.title: A pocketful of wonders
books.description: A slow walk helps Sam notice the small treasures that make an ordinary day extraordinary.
copy: Sam went for a slow walk. “What can we notice?” asked their grown-up.
A curled leaf, a smooth stone, and a bird’s little song became treasures to remember.
Sam left the living things where they belonged and carried the memories home.

books.title: The sleepy little fox
books.description: Fox follows a cosy evening routine and learns that resting is part of every adventure.
copy: Fox wanted one more adventure, but the stars were already coming out.
A wash, a warm cuddle, and a familiar story helped Fox feel cosy and safe.
“Tomorrow has room for more adventures,” whispered Fox, curling up for a restful night.
